name: Financial Support Scheme
benefit: **S. No.****Family income (in ₹) per annum****Fee waiver (percentage)****Remarks**Category 1Less than or equal to ₹ 4,00,000/Up to 100%Actual fee or up to a maximum of ₹ 15000/-Category 2Between ₹ 4,00,000/- and ₹ 8,00,000/-Up to 50%Actual fee or up to a maximum of ₹ 10,000/-
_eligibility_text: - A full-time bonafide student studying in any UG/PG Program in a department/institute/center of the University of Delhi (UoD). - The family income of the student should be less than ₹ 8,00,000/-. - Students enrolled in constituent colleges of UoD. - B.Tech Programs (excluding CIC) Five-year integrated LAW programs, SoL and NCWEB are NOT eligible.
